import re

# Use note 3084 (Spice Symphony Kitchen) as dinner yesterday likely
note_content = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=sn_token)['content']
print('note 3084 content:\n', note_content)

# Parse lines like '- Name => $amount'
items=[]
for line in note_content.splitlines():
    m=re.match(r"-\s*(.+?)\s*=>\s*\$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*$", line.strip())
    if m:
        name=m.group(1).strip()
        amount=float(m.group(2))
        items.append((name,amount))
print('parsed items', items)

# Venmo received tx list already in all_rx. Filter description == 'Friends Dinner'
rx_fd=[t for t in all_rx if t.get('description')=='Friends Dinner']
print('rx_fd count', len(rx_fd))
print([(t['sender']['name'], t['sender']['email'], t['amount'], t['created_at']) for t in rx_fd])

# Extract first names from sender['name'] for matching with note first names
rx_first=set()
rx_map={}  # first -> list of (email, amount)
for t in rx_fd:
    first=t['sender']['name'].split()[0]
    rx_first.add(first)
    rx_map.setdefault(first, []).append((t['sender']['email'], t['amount']))
print('rx_first', rx_first)

note_first=set(name for name,_ in items)
print('note_first', note_first)

paid_first=note_first.intersection(rx_first)
missing_first=note_first-paid_first
print('paid_first', paid_first)
print('missing_first', missing_first)

# Build missing list with amounts
missing=[(name,amt) for name,amt in items if name in missing_first]
print('missing', missing)
